references.text: Then God said: "Let us make humans in our image, after our likeness. They shall rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds under heaven, over the cattle and all wild animals, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth."

Then the Lord came down to see the city and the tower that the people were building. The Lord said: "See, they are one people, and they have all one language. And this is only the beginning of what they will do! Now nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them."
Then I heard the voice of the Lord. He said: "Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?" I said: "Here I am; send me!"

Then they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak in other languages as the Spirit gave them ability to proclaim. In Jerusalem there lived devout Jewish men from every nation under heaven. When this sound was heard, the crowd gathered and were bewildered because each one heard their own language being spoken. They were completely amazed and said: "Are not all these who are speaking Galileans? How then can each of us hear our own native language?"
The Lord will bring a nation against you from far away, from the ends of the earth. It will come like an eagle swooping down, a people whose language you do not understand.
